text:
Two bookmarks fall out of one book. One has your friend’s initials.

我还给你吧。
Wǒ huán gěi nǐ ba.
Let me give it back to you.

Here 还 is huán, meaning to return something.

Your paper plane flies two feet and lands under a chair. Your friend hands it back and says:

再飞一次吧。
Zài fēi yí cì ba.
Let’s fly it one more time.

再 + verb is a handy way to suggest another try.
